_note: Declared aggregate on-disk retention ceiling for the sm_86 live-capture corpus (compressed .pb.zst traces + label sidecars + control-bits). The preflight gate refuses to start a capture session unless free disk on the output filesystem exceeds this ceiling, so a session cannot begin and then wedge halfway through a multi-GB atomic-heavy cell. Per-cell size/runtime budgets remain the province of tools/cloud/trace_budgets.py; this is the coarse session-admission ceiling.
rationale: Previously-dropped atomic/async records now carry 32-lane address vectors; the atomic histogram cell alone is ~411M records / multi-GB before compression. The sum of explicit runnable-cell retained ceilings plus the 8 GiB metadata margin must remain within the 200 GiB corpus ceiling. Preflight separately reserves 16 GiB for one compression/sampling workspace while the raw trace and its retained replacement coexist.
